{{Quote|The Tarkin family of Eriadu played a critical, but mostly offstage, role in shaping galactic politics.|[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>}} 
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''Tarkin family''' consisted of several members from the world of [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]]. The family had been at the forefront of the galactic cultural elite for much of the Republic's history, producing many great military commanders, engineers, politicians, writers, and artists.<ref name="Sourcebook">''[[Rebellion Era Sourcebook]]''</ref> They included [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], [[Shayla Paige-Tarkin]], senator of Eriadu around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], and [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]], senator of Eriadu around [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]]. The Tarkins had a bitter, feuding relationship with the [[House Valorum/Legends|Valorums]] (at least the ones living on Eriadu); however, the Tarkins were integral in helping [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] be elected [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor of the Republic]] in the [[Supreme Chancellor election, 40 BBY|elections]] of [[40 BBY/Legends|40 BBY]].

They were the most powerful family of the [[Quintad/Legends|Quintad]], a group of five powerful families that ruled the planet Eriadu and originated on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]] before emigrating to Eriadu around [[900 BBY/Legends|900 BBY]].

The Tarkins became related to the [[Motti family]] of [[Phelarion/Legends|Phelarion]] thanks to the marriage of [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] and [[Thalassa Tarkin|Thalassa Motti]].

[[Sander Delvardus]] was a member of the extended Tarkin family.

==Behind the scenes==
Author [[John Ostrander]] originally envisioned Ranulph as the uncle of Wilhuff. However, ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' established them as cousins.
